title: Off the Dock
lines: Josh and Nick fish off the dock with Dad.
Josh gets a big fish in his net.
Nick tugs and tugs. He gets a shell.
Then Nick tugs up a wet sock!
"That is not a fish!" said Nick.
"Sit and hush. Do not let go," said Dad.
Nick sits. Then his rod dips and dips!
Up it hops. "Such a big fish!" said Josh.

questions.ask: What does Nick pull up before he gets a fish?
questions.listenFor: A shell and a wet sock. Two things - if they name only one, ask "and what else?"

questions.ask: What does Dad tell Nick to do?
questions.listenFor: Sit still, be quiet, and do not let go. It is the line in quote marks - have them find the talking.

questions.ask: Nick pulled up a shell and a sock before the fish came. What do you think kept him going? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: There is no wrong answer. You are listening for a reason from the story, like Dad told him to hold on, or he wanted a fish like Josh.
